name: Lovelust: Project Stockholm
source: Play as a college student who impulsively kidnaps his classmate or teacher as he struggles with his past and deals with the present. With multiple endings, it is your choice to do the right thing or the lewd thing. Is the connection you two share real? All the things you two have done, the fun you two have had, were they all fake? Was any of this worth it?​
translation: 扮演一名大学生，在与过去挣扎、应对当下的过程中，一时冲动绑架了自己的同学或老师。游戏拥有多个结局，是选择做正确的事，还是放纵情欲，由你决定。你们之间的联系是真实的吗？一起做过的一切、共同度过的快乐时光，难道全是假的？这一切，真的值得吗？
